sections.text_helper: Section 19.4.9 "TIM14 prescaler (TIM14_PSC)" in chapter 19 (General-purpose timers (TIM14)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 541.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x28
Reset value: 0x0000
Bits 15:0 PSC[15:0]: Prescaler value
The counter clock frequency CK_CNT is equal to fCK_PSC / (PSC[15:0] + 1).
PSC contains the value to be loaded in the active prescaler register at each update event.
(including when the counter is cleared through UG bit of TIMx_EGR register or through trigger
controller when configured in “reset mode”).
